scientific_question: When arm/workload is block-randomized independently of global execution order and non-invasive state covariates are recorded before every cell, does the W-S non-material / W-C material total-transfer split replicate, and after nuisance-state balancing do B-A and C-B become stably identifiable?

hypotheses.H_TOTAL_SPLIT: C/A remains non-material on W-S and material on W-C after order-balanced replication.
hypotheses.H_DECOMPOSITION_IDENTIFIABLE: Within-block B/A and C/B classifications become stable across balanced blocks.
hypotheses.H_NUISANCE_ONLY: Large block/session state variation remains, but balanced within-block contrasts are stable and therefore identifiable.
hypotheses.H_ANL64_INSTABILITY: B/A or C/B remains materially unstable after exact order/carryover balance, arguing that the instability is treatment-specific rather than a global-order nuisance.

arms.A_CANONICAL: current canonical runtime; no ANL64 plan
arms.B_PLAN_PREBOUND: exact ANL64 immutable plan prebound before timing; canonical executor choices preserved
arms.C_PLAN_PREBOUND_RESIDUAL: same prebound plan plus only residual 84 Q/K/O Q4_FAST substitutions

pre_cell_state_covariates.collection_point: immediately before each cell process launch and outside all inference timing
pre_cell_state_covariates.extended_surface_freeze_rule: Availability and exact acquisition command must be frozen before first P3 performance observation. A field unavailable at preflight is marked UNAVAILABLE for the entire study; it may not be introduced mid-study.
prohibited: GPU/CPU hardware-counter sessions attached to inference
adaptive cooldown or executor changes based on observed performance
pre_cell_state_covariates.decision_role: covariates diagnose nuisance balance and residual state association; they cannot change thresholds, delete cells, reorder treatments, or rescue a failed primary gate

primary_estimands.cross_block_summary: median of the six within-block ratios
primary_estimands.why: complete blocking removes block-wide level shifts from the primary treatment contrasts

frozen_materiality_thresholds.source: carried forward from P1R; not tuned to P2 outcome

replication_rules.block_stability_requirement: at least 5 of 6 blocks must agree with the pooled classification for a contrast to be called stable
replication_rules.W_S_total_split_replication: median C/A does not satisfy both material-benefit thresholds AND at least 5/6 blocks are non-material
replication_rules.W_C_total_split_replication: median C/A satisfies decode>=1.1 and E2E<=0.9 AND at least 5/6 blocks are material
replication_rules.total_TTFT_guard: median C/A TTFT<=1.1 AND at least 5/6 blocks have C/A TTFT<=1.1
replication_rules.plan_identifiable: for each workload, pooled B/A no-harm classification is matched by at least 5/6 blocks
replication_rules.residual_identifiable: for each workload, pooled C/B material-vs-nonmaterial classification is matched by at least 5/6 blocks
replication_rules.ANL64_specific_instability: after exact position/carryover balance, B/A or C/B still fails the 5/6 stability rule while canonical-A block variation alone cannot explain the contrast reversal

nuisance_analysis.primary: block-balanced paired contrasts; no covariate adjustment required for primary adjudication
secondary: descriptive association of canonical-A cell medians with global ordinal and recorded state covariates
descriptive association of within-block residuals with recorded state covariates
check that covariate distributions are not systematically aliased with A/B/C after frozen schedule
nuisance_analysis.mechanism_claim_boundary: thermal, frequency, cache, driver or other specific nuisance mechanism may be named only if the corresponding covariate is actually observed and shows preregistered replicated association; otherwise retain nuisance-class wording

blocking_guards: exact token equality across matched A/B/C cells
adjudication_order: G0 evidence completeness and frozen schedule identity
